## ICdcTailOptions interface

Tail options — consumer resume, lower bound, and batch cap.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ICdcTailOptions 
```

## Remarks

A named `consumer` auto-registers on first tail (floor 0) and later tails resume past its ack. An explicit `from` repositions forward past the ack but never backward.
